description_expanded: OverviewNewly renovated Private Pool/Heat Option - Golf Cart Option - Walk to Seaside - Public Beach - 2 Minute Walk -3 Bikes-Dogwood CottageThe Space Dogwood Cottage | Cozy beach Cottage Near SeasideHOME HIGHLIGHTS: Walking Distance to the Beach – Just a 3-minute stroll to the sugar-white sands 3 Free Beach Bikes – Explore Seaside & 30A in style Private Pool (Heat Option Available) – Perfect for relaxing after a beach day Outdoor Grill – Fire up some fresh seafood & enjoy dining al fresco Walking Distance to Seaside – Shops, restaurants & live entertainment just steps away Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected & stream your favorites Driveway Parking for Two Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacationing Pool Heating Available – October 1st – May 1st ($50/day, not guaranteed)Welcome to Dogwood CottageThis fabulous location is perfect for a family vacation, just off 30A without all the hustle and bustle! Once you arrive, you can park your car and walk or bike to Seaside, Seagrove and Watercolor, which are just a short distance away! This area is so special with the tree lined roads, and yet so close to the beautiful white sugar sand beaches, which are a quick three-minute walk away.This 2019 renovated coastal cottage is great for a small family getaway! It is a cozy two story with a reverse floor plan. It has three bedrooms plus an open bunk area that offers flexibility in sleeping arrangements, along with two bathrooms and one-half bathroom. Completely renovated and expanded in 2019! Newly renovated bathrooms, kitchen, custom bunk beds, freshly painted and new flooring December 2019. All new appliances! The dining table seats six. The living area, three bedrooms and each bunk bed have their own TV. This home has cable and wireless internet.Dogwood Cottage is located in Old Seagrove Beach which is a quiet, residential area, less than 150 yards to the beach and only one block east of Seaside. You can enjoy all that Seaside has to offer - shopping, restaurants, and live entertainment - which is just a 4-minute walk, through the shaded tree lined side streets. Your children can ride bikes into Seaside without ever getting on a busy road.Features of the cottage include a bright open floor plan upstairs with a living area, dining area and kitchen. Natural light filters in through the large windows in the stairwell tower. The ensuite queen bedroom is just off the living room. The attached bathroom was newly renovated in 2019. A flat screen TV is located in the queen bedroom and the living room.There are two beautiful bedrooms on the ground floor which each have a King bed, and they share a newly renovated bathroom across the hall which includes a double sink vanity, toilet and a large shower. Just off the main entry of the cottage is a half bathroom, and towards the rear of the home is a set of custom bunk beds.New pool added Spring 2020, along with a back porch! The large backyard is great for hanging out after playing at the beach. There is an outdoor shower conveniently located on the side of the home.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Note:No oversized vehicles allowed: RV's, trailers, boatsNo street parkingPool Heat *Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st*Pool heat max temperature is 82 degrees*Fee $50 per day / $350 per week*Heating applies to the entire stay, may be added after arrival*48 hour advanced notice required to add pool heatSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):2nd floor Bedroom: Queen sized bed - private bath stand up shower1st floor Bedroom: King size bed – shared bath1st floor Bedroom: Queen sized bed – shared bath1st floor Bunkroom: Twin over twin Bunk BedAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand.Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
